_comment: Real golden evaluation dataset for SeekThreat Layer 2 enrichment coverage against an NVD-only baseline.
verification: batch-attested by Mayank Narang 2026-10-11; no per-CVE evidence records yet; cohort labels B (nvd_gap) and D (high_epss_no_nvd) are contradicted by the measured data (NVD supplied CVSS for all)
selection_rule: none documented yet: the 50 CVEs are hand-picked well-known CVEs; evals/golden/eval_cve_list.txt is the same list used as sync input
